strategies.name: sma_cross
strategies.description: Goes long when the fast moving average crosses above the slow one, and short or flat when it crosses below.

strategies.name: rsi_reversion
strategies.description: Buys when RSI falls below its oversold level and sells when it recovers to the middle.

strategies.name: donchian_breakout
strategies.description: Enters on a close beyond the highest high or lowest low of the channel, with an ATR stop.

strategies.name: funding_carry
strategies.description: Holds the side of a perpetual that collects funding while the rate stays above its threshold.
